home.headline: Dreams written by the waves. Serenity born of love.
home.support: Holiday Villa Thassos is your place for refined calm and dreamlike sea tenderness.
home.welcomeTitle: Welcome to Holiday Villa Thassos — your island home on the Aegean shore!
home.welcomeBody: Thassos — the island of golden sunsets and emerald waters, where nature itself creates a sense of luxury.
home.welcomeBody2: Here the sea is not just a view — it is part of how you feel. Holiday Villa Thassos is a place where morning begins with a breeze that awakens the soul, and evenings dissolve into golden sunsets over the azure horizon.
home.welcomeBody3: Our villa blends calm, elegant comfort and that true Greek spirit that makes time move more slowly. Bright studios, sea-view apartments, terraces that embrace the sky… everything is created so you feel free, rested and inspired. Our 4 studios and 4 apartments are the ideal choice for families and friends seeking a peaceful, comfortable and exciting holiday by the sea on Thassos.
home.welcomeGarden: Our olive garden offers two cozy BBQ areas where the scent of Greek summer mixes with the song of cicadas, as well as free private parking for your convenience. Here every minute is an invitation to delight — aromatic coffee on the terrace, the quiet of the garden, the song of the waves, the warmth of the island sun.
home.welcomeAdventure: Looking for new experiences? Want adventure? Thassos awaits you with over 50 beaches, emerald bays, mountain trails, ancient sights and crystal-clear waters — the perfect blend of calm and emotion.
home.welcomeLicense: Holiday Villa Thassos holds an official license from the Greek Ministry of Tourism — MHTE License: 0155K112K0106800, a guarantee of quality, safety and premium standards.
home.adventureTitle: Are you looking for new experiences and thrills?
home.adventureSubtitle: Do you wish to embark on an adventure?
home.adventureBody: The beautiful sandy Paradise Beach is located two kilometers to the south. It is famous for its amazing sights, azure seas, fine sand and crystal clear waters. The nearby rocks are a tempting site for snorkeling enthusiasts. Not surprisingly Paradise Beach has been awarded with a Blue Flag.
home.adventureGolden: Also, six kilometers to the north you will find the popular Golden Beach. Cafes, taverns and shops are in close proximity. If you dream of spending your holiday at a beautiful location surrounded by olive trees, sand and sea, your heaven is here with us!
home.commodities: Our studios and apartments offer all necessary commodities for a pleasant stay.
home.tourTeaserBody: Explore our studios and apartments from anywhere before you book.
home.staysBody: Eight self-catering units for families and friends — garden terraces below, sea-view balconies above.

accommodation.title: Accommodation
accommodation.intro: Four bright studios and four apartments — created for comfort, calm and a true island feeling in Kinira.
accommodation.studiosView: Up to 4 guests · Terrace · Garden with BBQ
accommodation.studiosBody: Our studios at Holiday Villa Thassos are created for guests seeking comfort, calm and a true island feeling. Each studio is bright, modernly furnished and offers a cozy atmosphere where the sea is always within easy reach.
accommodation.studiosFeature1: A separate bedroom with a large double bed and a bunk bed, in a stylish and cozy interior
accommodation.studiosFeature2: A fully equipped kitchenette — ideal for breakfast or a light dinner
accommodation.studiosFeature3: A terrace with a view, where morning coffee tastes different
accommodation.studiosFeature4: Air conditioning and high-speed WiFi for maximum comfort
accommodation.studiosFeature5: Cleanliness and coziness, maintained daily with attention to detail
accommodation.studiosFeature6: A peaceful garden with BBQ areas available to all guests
accommodation.studiosFeature7: Free private parking on the villa grounds
accommodation.studiosClosing: The studios are the ideal choice for couples, families or friends who want to enjoy quiet, nature and the azure beaches of Thassos. They are suitable for families of up to 4 people (2 adults + 2 children). Here every morning begins with a sea breeze, and every evening ends with Greek music and the aroma of ouzo.
accommodation.apartmentsView: Up to 4 guests · Sea or garden view · Terrace
accommodation.apartmentsBody: The apartments at Holiday Villa Thassos are created for guests who value comfort, calm and that special feeling when the sea is part of every moment. Bright and stylishly furnished, they offer the perfect blend of home comfort and island romance.
accommodation.apartmentsFeature1: A living area with comfortable beds and modern furniture
accommodation.apartmentsFeature2: A fully equipped kitchenette, suitable for breakfast, coffee or a light dinner
accommodation.apartmentsFeature3: A modern bathroom, maintained with attention to detail
accommodation.apartmentsFeature4: Air conditioning and high-speed WiFi for maximum comfort
accommodation.apartmentsFeature5: A terrace with a beautiful view of the sea or garden, where every sip of coffee is more fragrant and every sunset gentler
accommodation.apartmentsClosing: But the greatest treasure of the apartments is the view. The sea is your constant companion — morning greets you with light, afternoon shines in azure blue, and evening spills into gold. The terrace becomes a private place for rest, conversation and moments that stay in the heart. An apartment comfortably sleeps up to 4 people (two adults in a separate bedroom and two children on a bunk bed).

villaPolicy.title: Stay & reservation policy at Holiday Villa Thassos
villaPolicy.intro: Created for guests who value calm, quality and fairness.
villaPolicy.reservationsBody1: A reservation is confirmed after receipt of a 30% advance payment.
villaPolicy.reservationsBody2: The remaining balance is paid before check-in.
villaPolicy.reservationsBody3: Payments may be made by bank transfer, bank card or another pre-agreed method.
villaPolicy.cancelBody1: Free cancellation is possible up to 60 days before the arrival date.
villaPolicy.cancelBody2: For cancellations within 60 days before arrival, the full reservation amount is due.
villaPolicy.cancelBody3: In case of no-show, 100% of the amount is retained.
villaPolicy.cancelBody4: Date changes are accepted subject to availability and do not guarantee the original price.
villaPolicy.checkInBody3: Early check-in or late check-out is provided when possible and may be charged additionally.
villaPolicy.rulesIntro: Important rules for public order and quiet hours
villaPolicy.rulesQuietIntro: Dear guests, please note that in Greece the law strictly regulates quiet hours during the summer season (from 1 April to 30 September). To ensure a comfortable stay for everyone, please observe the following rules:
villaPolicy.rulesQuietForbidden: During these hours the following is strictly prohibited: loud talking, shouting, loud music or television (in rooms as well as on terraces and in the yard), noisy parties and the use of noisy appliances.
villaPolicy.rulesLegal: Legal consequences: local authorities impose strict sanctions for noise violations, including fines. Please respect the peace of other guests and neighbours.
villaPolicy.rulesCapacity: Each apartment/studio has a strictly defined maximum capacity.
villaPolicy.rulesExtraGuests: Additional guests may stay only with prior approval.
villaPolicy.cleaningBody1: Cleaning is carried out every day, and linen is changed every 3 nights.
villaPolicy.cleaningBody2: Guests must take care of the property and report any damage.
villaPolicy.cleaningBody3: Damage caused during the stay is charged after assessment and valuation.
villaPolicy.securityBody1: The villa has security systems and video surveillance in common outdoor areas.
villaPolicy.securityBody2: The owner is not responsible for lost or unattended personal belongings.
villaPolicy.securityBody3: Guests must lock the premises when leaving.
villaPolicy.paymentsBody1: All prices are in euros and include tourist taxes.
villaPolicy.paymentsBody2: Additional services are paid on site.
villaPolicy.respectBody: Holiday Villa Thassos is a place created for calm, comfort and a quality stay. We expect the same respect from our guests toward the property, nature and other visitors, so we can preserve the harmony and peaceful atmosphere that make a stay here so special.
villaPolicy.respectThanks: Thank you for choosing Holiday Villa Thassos — a place where calm is a value, and kindness makes every holiday more beautiful.

thassos.title: Thassos Island
thassos.subtitle: History, beauty and blue magic
thassos.intro: Thassos is the island of light and emerald sea — a place where nature paints turquoise bays, golden beaches and olive groves that reach the water. Called the “Emerald Island”, it impresses with over 50 beaches, many awarded the Blue Flag for cleanliness, safety and crystal-clear waters.
thassos.historyBody: Since antiquity Thassos has been known for its marble, wine and honey. Legends say Dionysus himself set foot here, and ancient Thracians and Greeks left temples, theatres and artifacts that still guard the spirit of the past. In the old town and archaeological museum you can see more than 3,000 years of history — from antique statues to Roman mosaics.
thassos.landmarksBody: Among the most impressive sights is Aliki — an ancient sanctuary complex and fortress on a rocky peninsula with turquoise waters. Stone paths, white rocks and the view of two bays make the place truly magical. The island is also dotted with small white churches and monasteries, such as the Monastery of Archangel Michael perched above the sea, and the historic Church of St. Athanasius in Panagia — symbols of spirituality and quiet.
thassos.beautyBody: The island’s beauty lies in contrasts — turquoise water, white rocks, olive groves and mountain peaks rising above the sea. Beaches such as Golden Beach, Paradise, Aliki and Marble Beach are known for their vivid colours, while the small coves of the eastern coast are a true paradise for those seeking calm and romance.
thassos.kiniraBody: Kinira is a small but charming village on the beautiful eastern coast of Thassos, 18 km southeast of Limenas. It sits in a quiet setting with wonderful landscapes and wins visitors’ hearts — they return again and again to enjoy the view. Directly opposite lies the tiny island of Kinira with steep rocky shores, covered in pine forests, adding extra charm to the scenery.

location.title: How to find us
location.byCarBody: From Keramoti take the ferry to Limenas (Thassos town), then drive south-east along the coastal road toward Kinira. From Kavala you can also ferry to Prinos and continue by road.
location.byPlaneBody: Closest airport: Kavala (KVA). Alternative: Thessaloniki (SKG). Rent a car or arrange a transfer to the ferry ports.
